{{Short description|Norwegian cell physiologist}}
{{distinguish|Trond Bergh}}
'''Trond Berg''' (born 1934) is a Norwegian [[Cell physiology|cell physiologist]].

He hails from the village of [[Svensby]] in [[Ullsfjord Municipality]]. After attending [[Troms Landsgymnas]] and the [[University of Oslo]], he took his PHD at [[Rutgers University]] in 1968. He became a professor at the [[University of Tromsø]] and the University of Oslo; professor emeritus from 2004. He is a member of the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] and won the [[Fridtjof Nansen Prize for Outstanding Research]] in 2008.<ref>{{cite news|title=Nansenprisen til ullsfjording|date=13 June 2008|work=[[Bladet Tromsø]]|page=20|language=no}}</ref><ref>{{cite web|url=https://dnva.no/medlemmer/24|title=Norske medlemmer|publisher=[[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]]|language=no|access-date=27 December 2021}}</ref>
